data.title: One Palm - Omniyat
data.about:
One Palm by Omniyat redefines luxury living on the world’s most famous address, Palm Jumeirah in Dubai. An architectural beauty, One Palm, offers an eclectic collection of 3 & 4 bedroom apartments and penthouses with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai’s skyline. 

With interiors designed by Super Potato and Elycion, and landscaping by Vladimir Djurovic, this amazing property is fully managed by Dorchester Collection, known for their portfolio of exclusive and high-end properties. If you want to live an elite lifestyle in Dubai, this is your home.

location_tile.title: At the center of the very best Dubai
location_tile.description:
One Palm is nestled in Palm Jumeirah, just minutes from Dubai Marina and Dubai Media City. It is close to major landmarks like the Atlantis The Palm, as well as commercial and touristic hubs.

  • 08 mins – Atlantis The Palm
  • 09 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 12 mins – JLT
  • 14 mins – Mall of Emirates
  • 17 mins – JBR
  • 25 mins – Dubai International Airport
  • 33 mins – Al Maktoum International Airport
